title: An oligo-swapping method: preparation of mismatch repair-monitoring substrate using a nicking endonuclease
author: Takedachi, Hayashida, et al.

steps.title: Purify pBET2 plasmid
steps.instruction: Purify pBET2 using a Nanobond Xtra Midi kit (typical yield ≈500 µg). Elute at high concentration and adjust the DNA to 0.5 mg/mL (≥500 ng/µL). Keep 0.4 µL as a control for agarose‑gel loading and store the remainder at 20 °C until loading.

steps.title: Create gapped DNA with Nt.BbvCI
steps.instruction: Mix 80 µL (40 µg ≈10 pmol) pBET2 (500 ng/µL), 4 µL Nt.BbvCI (10 000 U/mL), 20 µL 10× restriction endonuclease buffer, and 96 µL H₂O. Incubate 37 °C for 2 h, then heat‑inactivate at 80 °C for 20 min. Keep 1 µL as a gel‑loading sample to verify gapped DNA; store the rest at –20 °C.

steps.title: Anneal mismatch oligonucleotide
steps.instruction: To the gapped‑DNA mixture add 1 µL mismatch oligonucleotide (200 pmol/µL), 25 µL 10× restriction buffer, and 24 µL H₂O. Incubate 95 °C for 5 min, then 70 °C for 5 min, then at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Ligate oligo into gapped DNA
steps.instruction: Add 10.8 µL 25 mM ATP, 7 µL T4 DNA ligase (400 U/µL), and 2.5 µL H₂O. Incubate 16 °C overnight, then heat‑inactivate at 65 °C for 10 min. Keep 2.7 µL as a gel‑loading sample; store the reaction at –20 °C.

steps.title: Digest non‑mismatch DNA with SpeI-HF
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL SpeI‑HF (20 U/µL) to the ligation mixture. Incubate 37 °C for 1 h, then inactivate at 80 °C for 20 min. Keep 2.7 µL as a gel‑loading sample; store the remainder at –20 °C.

steps.title: Remove linear DNA with T5 exonuclease
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL T5 exonuclease (10 U/µL). Incubate 37 °C for 1 h. Keep 2.7 µL as a gel‑loading sample; store the resulting pBET2 C/A at –20 °C.

steps.title: Analyze products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run all reaction samples on a 0.8 % agarose gel containing EtBr, loading 200 ng per lane (with loading dye). Visualize DNA conformations (closed‑circular, open‑circular, linear) to confirm each step.

steps.title: Purify mismatched DNA substrate
steps.instruction: Purify the pBET2 C/A product using a PCR purification kit (MACHEREY‑NAGEL) or alternative EtBr‑CsCl gradient/gel extraction. Quantify by spectrophotometer, adjust to ≈100 ng/µL, aliquot, and store at –20 °C for up to a few months.

steps.title: Prepare substrate for MMR strand recognition
steps.instruction: Mix 50 µL purified mismatch substrate (100 ng/µL), 5 µL Nt.BspQI, 10 µL 10× restriction buffer, and 35 µL H₂O (final DNA 50 ng/µL, 5 µg total). Incubate 50 °C for 2 h, then inactivate at 80 °C for 20 min. This step is optional and performed after purification of pBET2 C/A.
